classification.notes: Article describes Basel Committee finalising amendments to address window-dressing in the G-SIB framework and a consultation on G-SIB methodology review. This is a prudential capital/regulatory methodology matter for global systemically important banks and does not describe any of the Step 1 world events covered by the card catalog (no Treasury/repo stress, no equity selloff, no clearing mandate milestone, no member default, no cyber event, no settlement disruption, etc.).
